items.title: Your chatbot has a biodiversity footprint. This service can help you pay for it
items.summary: Every query sent to ChatGPT, Claude and other artificial intelligence (AI) services has an impact on natural ecosystems that’s both real and, in practice, extremely challenging to assess.

items.title: Ørsted among Prince William’s Earthshot Prize 2026 Winners
items.summary: The Winners of this year's Earthshot Prize were revealed in a ceremony today (17 November) in Mumbai, including Ørsted, the nation of Bhutan and PFAS campaigners.

items.title: From an Ocean Compact to more TAFF roadmaps: What happened on 17 November at COP31?
items.summary: From small island states demanding climate finance to tackle plastic pollution to new pacts on wildlife, Ocean, Seas, Nature and Land Use Day put protecting the natural world firmly centre stage.

items.title: WEBINAR TOMORROW: How to turn climate risk insights into adaptation action
items.summary: This webinar, held in partnership with SmartResilience on 19 November, will explore why and how leading organisations are moving from simply measuring risk to actively adapting in order to protect their operations, assets and supply chains.

items.title: COP31 Covered podcast: From Yerevan to Antalya, joining up nature and climate
items.summary: The eighth episode of edie’s daily COP31 Covered podcast is streaming now, featuring an exclusive interview with Jason Dozier of the High Ambition Coalition (HAC) for Nature and People on whether the world’s 30x30 target for nature is still within reach.

items.title: COP31: UK backs call for sector-specific ‘polluter pays’ levies
items.summary: The UK has backed a call to make polluting sectors contribute to adaptation and mitigation finance, while new research found that the nation is leading in global efforts to increase the amount of government-backed export finance funnelled into net-zero initiatives.

items.title: Study: Businesses struggle to prove impact of social value action
items.summary: While most companies engage in social impact initiatives, few are able to quantify and report on the impact of these investments, new research has found.

items.title: Apply now: Entries open for the edie Awards 2027
items.summary: The UK’s largest corporate sustainability awards scheme is celebrating its 20th year with a restructured programme, built around three pillars and new categories including AI, water and adaptation.

items.title: UK SRS readiness assessment: How to identify reporting gaps before requirements tighten
items.summary: UK Sustainability Reporting Standards are set to change how organisations connect sustainability information with financial planning and business decisions.

items.title: What SMEs need to know before they invest in solar
items.summary: Solar power is booming in the UK, with most of the growth coming from rooftop installations.
